consulting.core_focus: Structured problem solving, business impact ($/₹ revenue, cost reduction, efficiency), market sizing, C-suite/stakeholder advisory, zero-to-one strategy frameworks.

software.core_focus: System architecture, low-latency performance, algorithmic complexity, full-stack scalability, APIs/microservices, modern tech stack, uptime/throughput (QPS/TPS), clean engineering.

product_management.core_focus: User empathy, product discovery, TAM/SAM sizing, roadmap execution, A/B testing, user acquisition/retention funnel (DAU/MAU, CTR, churn, NPS), cross-functional leadership between engineering/design/business.

finance.core_focus: Financial modeling (DCF, LBO, Comparable comps), valuation accuracy, IRR/ROI maximization, capital allocation, risk management, regulatory diligence, quantitative financial analysis.

analytics.core_focus: Predictive modeling, machine learning pipelines, ETL pipelines, statistical inference, feature engineering, dashboarding/BI automation, decision science metrics (AUC-ROC, F1-score, MAPE).

consulting_to_software.reframe_strategy: Shift from high-level business strategy to technical implementation and system architecture. Highlight underlying algorithms, data processing pipelines, software tools, and computational methods used during the project. De-emphasize client decks and stakeholder management unless it relates to technical sprint coordination.
consulting_to_software.metric_pivot: Convert high-level business impact into technical efficiency, algorithmic performance, processing time, or query optimization metrics if supported by raw vault descriptions.
consulting_to_software.flag_criteria: Points that are purely executive communication, client advisory, case competitions, or LoR/commendations with zero technical/analytical tooling.

consulting_to_product_management.reframe_strategy: Shift from external advisory/consultant lens to internal product ownership. Reframe market entry frameworks as product strategy and market sizing (TAM/SAM). Reframe competitor benchmarking as user research and feature gap analysis. Highlight user journey, MVP scoping, and North Star metrics.

verb_replacements.Formulated GTM strategy: Defined MVP roadmap and launch strategy
verb_replacements.Conducted 40+ interviews: Executed user research & discovery across 40+ target personas
verb_replacements.Synthesized benchmark: Prioritized feature backlog based on competitive tear-down

consulting_to_product_management.metric_pivot: Focus on user adoption, conversion rates, NPS, retention, and business growth metrics.
consulting_to_product_management.flag_criteria: Strict cost-cutting operational audit points that have no user, workflow, or product innovation component.

consulting_to_finance.reframe_strategy: Emphasize quantitative financial analysis, revenue/cost modeling, EBITDA impact, ROI calculations, and market valuation. Reframe strategic decisions into capital allocation, profitability drivers, and investment thesis validation.

verb_replacements.Evaluated market expansion: Conducted DCF/comparable valuation and risk sensitivity analysis
verb_replacements.Identified optimization levers: Quantified unit economics and cost optimization levers

consulting_to_finance.metric_pivot: Emphasize IRR, NPV, ROI, cost reduction in ₹/$, margin expansion, and financial valuation metrics.
consulting_to_finance.flag_criteria: Soft qualitative stakeholder alignment or organizational design points without financial/numerical rigor.

consulting_to_analytics.reframe_strategy: Amplify data extraction, quantitative modeling, statistical testing, SQL/Python scripts, and BI dashboards that powered the consulting findings. Transform qualitative recommendations into data-driven analytical models.

verb_replacements.Benchmarked market trends: Engineered automated ETL pipeline and cohort analysis
verb_replacements.Synthesized survey data: Conducted multi-variable regression and statistical clustering
verb_replacements.Presented recommendations: Designed executive BI dashboard tracking 15+ KPIs

consulting_to_analytics.metric_pivot: Highlight data scale (rows/records), model confidence, statistical significance, and dashboard automation hours.
consulting_to_analytics.flag_criteria: Purely qualitative organizational restructuring points with no quantitative data analysis.

software_to_consulting.reframe_strategy: Elevate technical details to business value, organizational scale, operational cost savings, and client/user impact. Frame software systems as business transformation initiatives. Highlight cross-functional leadership.

verb_replacements.Wrote REST API: Engineered automated core platform driving $X business operations
verb_replacements.Refactored database: Optimized enterprise infrastructure, slashing server overhead by X%
verb_replacements.Fixed critical bugs: Mitigated system vulnerabilities, safeguarding transaction continuity

software_to_consulting.metric_pivot: Translate latency/QPS into business metrics: revenue unlocked, operational hours saved, user capacity scaled.
software_to_consulting.flag_criteria: Niche syntax/library upgrades (e.g., 'Migrated React 17 to 18') with zero demonstrable business or user impact.

software_to_product_management.reframe_strategy: Shift from 'how it was coded' to 'what user problem was solved and why'. Highlight feature scoping, technical feasibility trade-offs, release management, user feedback iteration, and end-user adoption.

verb_replacements.Implemented frontend component: Shipped redesigned user interface, improving workflow completion by X%
verb_replacements.Built microservice: Launched core microservice enabling new product capability for X users
verb_replacements.Managed database schema: Structured data schema to support scalable multi-tenant product features

software_to_product_management.metric_pivot: Focus on user engagement, workflow completion rates, user retention, and feature adoption.
software_to_product_management.flag_criteria: Pure backend CI/CD plumbing or compiler optimizations that have no visible user impact or product workflow.

software_to_finance.reframe_strategy: Highlight computational finance, high-frequency low-latency transaction handling, algorithmic data processing, risk calculation modules, and cost reduction via cloud/infrastructure optimization.

verb_replacements.Engineered API: Engineered high-throughput financial transaction processing engine
verb_replacements.Optimized queries: Slashed computational query latency for real-time pricing analysis
verb_replacements.Built monitoring system: Created automated risk alerting and fraud detection pipeline

software_to_finance.metric_pivot: Highlight transaction volume processed ($/₹), cost per transaction, latency reduction for execution, and infrastructure ROI.
software_to_finance.flag_criteria: Pure consumer UI animations or design-heavy frontends with zero quantitative or financial relevance.

software_to_analytics.reframe_strategy: Highlight data pipelines, ETL architecture, database indexing, distributed computing (Spark, Hadoop, Kafka), machine learning model serving, and data warehouse integration.

verb_replacements.Built backend server: Constructed robust ETL and streaming pipeline handling X GB/day
verb_replacements.Created database tables: Architected distributed data lakehouse optimized for OLAP analytical queries
verb_replacements.Integrated third-party APIs: Automated data ingestion pipeline across 5+ external endpoints

software_to_analytics.metric_pivot: Highlight data throughput (GB/s, records/sec), query execution speed, pipeline reliability, and data lake scale.
software_to_analytics.flag_criteria: Pure UI styling or graphic design points.

product_management_to_consulting.reframe_strategy: Highlight strategic market research, competitive positioning, business case development, cross-functional stakeholder alignment, and top-line revenue/margin growth.

product_management_to_consulting.metric_pivot: Highlight market share captured, revenue generated, operational efficiency gained, and executive buy-in.
product_management_to_consulting.flag_criteria: Granular ticket management or JIRA grooming details without strategic or business outcomes.

product_management_to_software.reframe_strategy: Emphasize the technical architecture, data flow diagrams, API specifications, technical debt reduction, system integrations, and analytical experiments conducted.

product_management_to_software.flag_criteria: Pure user persona design or branding campaigns with zero software or technical engagement.

product_management_to_finance.reframe_strategy: Emphasize product unit economics (LTV/CAC, gross margin), monetization strategies, pricing tier models, revenue forecasting, and ROI on engineering investments.

product_management_to_finance.metric_pivot: Highlight ARR/MRR growth, LTV/CAC ratio, payback period, and gross margin improvements.
product_management_to_finance.flag_criteria: Qualitative design thinking workshops without financial or commercial metrics.

product_management_to_analytics.reframe_strategy: Highlight A/B testing methodologies, cohort retention analysis, funnel drop-off analytics, telemetry data instrumentation, and data-driven prioritization algorithms.

product_management_to_analytics.flag_criteria: Qualitative PR announcements or creative copy reviews with no empirical data.
